stories.title: OpenAI math breakthroughs spark 'bunker mode' warning from Bitcoin researcher
stories.summary: Bitcoin researcher Justin Drake warned that recent OpenAI math breakthroughs could force a 'bunker mode' response. The report does not detail the specific breakthrough or what bunker mode would involve. The concern touches on AI's growing capability and its possible impact on cryptographic systems.
stories.whyItMatters: If AI progress threatens the cryptography behind Bitcoin, that is a long-term risk for every holder, not just a technical footnote.
whatToWatch: Follow-up detail from Drake on the specific threat.
Response from Bitcoin core developers or OpenAI.
questions: What math breakthrough triggered this warning?
What would 'bunker mode' actually require Bitcoin to do?

sources.title: OpenAI math breakthroughs raise ‘bunker mode’ alarm from Bitcoin researcher Justin Drake

stories.title: US government moves $470 million in seized crypto to Coinbase wallets
stories.summary: The US government transferred $470 million in seized crypto to wallets on Coinbase. The move has raised questions about whether a sale is coming. No official statement on the purpose of the transfer is cited.
stories.whyItMatters: A government sale at this size could add real selling pressure to Bitcoin markets and shows how authorities handle forfeited crypto.
whatToWatch: Official confirmation of the transfer's purpose.
Any on-chain sale activity from the wallets.
questions: Is this a sale, a custody move, or something else?
Which case does this seized crypto come from?

sources.title: US government moves $470 million in seized crypto to Coinbase wallets, raising Bitcoin sale questions

stories.title: Ethereum falls 6%, putting $1.35 billion in long bets at risk
stories.summary: Ethereum's price dropped 6%, pushing $1.35 billion in leveraged long positions toward liquidation. The drop adds to a run of volatile sessions across major crypto assets.
stories.whyItMatters: Large liquidation risk can speed up a price decline, since forced selling often feeds on itself.
whatToWatch: Whether liquidations trigger a deeper drop.
Ethereum's price action over the next day or two.

stories.title: Bitcoin up 84% since January 2024 despite rising Treasury yields
stories.summary: Bitcoin has gained 84% since January 2024, a stretch in which US Treasury yields also climbed. Higher yields are usually seen as a drag on risk assets, so the report flags the combination as notable.
stories.whyItMatters: The pattern challenges the assumption that rising yields hurt Bitcoin, a factor investors weigh when reading macro signals.
whatToWatch: Whether the pattern holds if yields keep rising.
questions: What is actually driving Bitcoin's gains here?

sources.title: Bitcoin price has risen 84% since January 2024 while Treasury yields climbed

stories.title: Robinhood adds $25 million of Bitcoin to its balance sheet
stories.summary: Robinhood added $25 million of Bitcoin to its own corporate balance sheet. This follows a wider trend of public companies holding Bitcoin as a treasury asset.
stories.whyItMatters: Corporate treasury buying adds steady demand and signals confidence from a major retail brokerage.
whatToWatch: Whether Robinhood adds to the position further.
questions: What is Robinhood's long-term plan for this holding?

stories.title: XRP ETFs hold $1.7 billion, but inflows slow to $4 million last week
stories.summary: XRP exchange-traded funds now hold $1.7 billion in assets, but last week's inflows slowed to just $4 million. The sharp slowdown follows an initial burst of launch demand.
stories.whyItMatters: Inflow trends show whether institutional appetite for XRP products is holding up or fading.
whatToWatch: Whether inflows rebound in coming weeks.
How XRP ETF flows compare to Bitcoin and Ethereum funds.

stories.title: Bitcoin drops to $84k, triggers $143 million in liquidations as ETF inflows turn positive
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell to $84,000, causing $143 million in liquidations, even as spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded positive inflows. Leveraged traders took losses while longer-term ETF buyers kept adding.
stories.whyItMatters: The split between leveraged-trader pain and steady ETF demand is a useful read on how different parts of the market see this dip.
whatToWatch: Whether ETF inflows continue despite price weakness.
questions: Is ETF buying absorbing the liquidation-driven selling?

sources.title: Bitcoin drops to $84k sees $143 million in liquidations as ETF inflows turn positive

stories.title: Japan's ¥2.6 trillion foreign debt sale: what Bitcoin investors should watch
stories.summary: Japanese institutions sold ¥2.6 trillion in foreign debt. The report ties this move to broader global capital flows that could affect Bitcoin and other risk assets.
stories.whyItMatters: Large shifts in Japanese capital flows have moved global bond yields and risk appetite before, and that can spill into Bitcoin.
whatToWatch: Any follow-on move in US Treasury yields.
Whether Bitcoin reacts if the selling continues.
questions: What is driving the Japanese selling?

stories.title: XRP treasury SPAC falls 50% in a day ahead of Evernorth's Nasdaq debut
stories.summary: A SPAC tied to an XRP treasury strategy dropped 50% in a single day, just ahead of Evernorth's planned Nasdaq debut. The sharp fall raises questions about investor appetite for crypto treasury vehicles built around tokens other than Bitcoin.
stories.whyItMatters: The selloff tests whether the crypto-treasury-company model, popular with Bitcoin, can work for XRP as well.
whatToWatch: Evernorth's Nasdaq debut and its market reception.
Whether the SPAC's price stabilizes afterward.

stories.title: Polymarket's upgrade won't automatically move existing bets to new contracts
stories.summary: Polymarket is rolling out a contract upgrade, but existing bets will not move to the new contracts automatically. Users with open positions may need to take action themselves to migrate them.
stories.whyItMatters: Prediction markets are a growing part of crypto, and migration friction could affect users who hold active positions on the platform.
whatToWatch: The timeline for the full upgrade rollout.
questions: What happens to bets that are not migrated?
Is there a deadline to move positions?
